title: Why is the sky blue?
one_liner: Air bounces blue sunlight around much more than red, so blue reaches your eyes from all over the sky.
analogy: Sunlight is like a bag of coloured marbles, and the air bounces the blue ones all over the place.
body: Sunlight looks white, but it is really all the colours mixed together. When it comes into the sky, it bumps into tiny bits of air. The blue light bounces around the most. So when you look up, blue light comes at you from everywhere.

key_fact.label: Blue light bounces about 4 times more than red

diagram.caption: Sunlight comes in, the air bounces the blue around, and blue reaches your eyes from every direction.

nodes.label: Tiny bits of air
